convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorBullsBearsEyes indicator and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh for trading logic (open/close positions). Custom indicator means signal generation cannot be replicated with built-in indicators alone.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before calculation
derived_values.used_by: OnTick bar sufficiency check and indicator handle validation

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade signal timestamp

other_exits: Opposite signal triggers close of existing position: sell signal closes long, buy signal closes short

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: negative values treated as fixed lot size (abs value), positive values treated as deposit fraction for risk-based sizing

custom_logic_notes: The EA reads buffer index 2 from ColorBullsBearsEyes which returns a trend direction value: +2=strong buy signal, +1=weak bullish, 0=neutral, -1=weak bearish, -2=strong sell signal. Entry only on extreme values (+2/-2). The AlgMode enum controls how the custom indicator generates signals: twist (direction change), breakdown1 (middle line crossover), breakdown2 (overbought/oversold level breakout), breakdown3 (exit from extremes + level breakout). SignalBar=1 means the EA reads the previous closed bar's signal, not the current forming bar. Permission booleans (BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen, BuyPosClose, SellPosClose) act as gates on trade execution. Recount flag ensures signal recalculation if data copy fails or insufficient bars.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorBullsBearsEyes custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python. It appears to be a smoothed Bulls/Bears ratio with gamma smoothing, generating discrete trend signals (-2,-1,0,+1,+2) based on level breakouts. The algorithm mode (breakdown2 default) means signals fire when the oscillator crosses the 75/25 overbought/oversold levels. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose wrappers that handle order placement, position checking, and MM logic - these must be reimplemented. The conditional MM logic (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction) is a common MQL5 pattern. No digit adjustment is performed on SL/TP values, so they are in raw points (1000 points SL, 2000 points TP).
